name: Vampire Saga: Welcome to Hell Lock
summary: You're riding along on your motorcycle when you lose control. Next thing you know, you're in front of a sign welcoming you to a town called Hill Lock but someone has crossed out the 'i' and replaced it with an 'e'. The town looks to have a coal fire burning beneath it and looks to be empty. But looks can be deceiving.
